topic: the Battle of Karansebes (1788) -- an army that may have fought and defeated itself
title: The Army That May Have Completely Defeated Itself
description: AI-narrated commentary on the 1788 Battle of Karansebes -- a night the Austrian army may have panicked in the dark and fired on itself, with no enemy soldier anywhere nearby.

hook_candidates.text: One army may have completely defeated itself, with zero enemy soldiers anywhere nearby.
What if an army spent an entire battle fighting only itself?
You'd think a battle needs two armies, but this one might have only had one.
In 1788, Austrian troops got free liquor from local peasants, and chaos followed.

share_trigger: A viewer sends this to the friend who thinks military history is always deadly serious and disciplined.
contradicted_belief: Most people assume an army can only be defeated by an actual enemy, never by itself.
closing_comment: This might be the one army in history that actually defeated itself, real or not.

sources.note: Confirms the 1788 incident and that historians dispute whether it happened as described, with no record until decades later.
